summary.text: Jim Arciero is a Democratic state representative from Westford who has represented the 2nd Middlesex District since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is House chair of the Joint Committee on Transportation and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Arciero, listed in legislative records as James Arciero, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts Dartmouth and a master's degree in public administration from Suffolk University, and he graduated from Westford Academy.
He served on the University of Massachusetts Board of Trustees from 1996 to 1997 and is a member of the Westford Democratic Town Committee.
Arciero has served in the Massachusetts House since 2009.
He was House chair of the Joint Committee on Housing from 2021 to 2024 and has been House chair of the Joint Committee on Transportation since 2025.
